limitations: Only three sites, central initial state and detuning, uniform independent dephasing, sink rate equal to hopping; mean capture time only.
scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of strict convexity and unique optimal homogeneous dephasing, including explicit rational capture time, finite-size/Markov assumptions, and exact symbolic positivity certificates. Publication priority requires independent verification.
title: Strict convexity and a detuning-monotone noise optimum for a middle-initialized quantum trimer
